description.text:
Start Deck 100 (起始卡组100) came out on 17 May 2024: 102 different ready-to-play 60-card decks, numbered 001 to 102, each sold in a box with damage counters and markers and a card showing the deck's number and its main Pokémon's type. The decks were built to be close in strength, so that new and experienced players could have an even game, and to be changed afterwards. Every deck has a Pokémon V, some have a Pokémon VMAX, and every deck has Ultra Ball.

New cards in it include Kingler V and VMAX, Zamazenta V with the Ability Regal Stance, Liepard with the Ability Trade, a Darkness Morpeko V, the first in the Sword & Shield series, and the Supporters Marnie's Pride and Team Yell's Cheer, with Professor's Research and Boss's Orders in new art. From 1 June to 22 December 2024, gyms and partner shops ran 100 Battles (100战百胜) events where each player drew a random deck and played with it as it came. Its cards are numbered out of 414; full-art and gold cards, among them gold Galarian Articuno V, Galarian Zapdos V, Galarian Moltres V and basic Energy, are numbered 415 to 433.
